baseline_kernel: SGLang AUTO -> DeepGEMM fp8_paged_mqa_logits split mode, then topk_transform_512_v2

bottleneck.evidence: NCU records a 148-CTA one-wave score launch with only 15.52-15.85% active warps, 0.125-0.146 eligible warps/cycle, 21.80-33.32% DRAM read peak, and dominant long-scoreboard sampling; Nsys shows separate fill, score, and top-k launches.

approaches.summary: Switch only the exact paged score backend to SGLang's shipped SM100 CuTe-DSL implementation while preserving fused FP8 Q/K, FP32 gates, compact page tables, and top-k-v2.
approaches.why: CUDA-graph M16 series were 1.019197x, 1.003703x, and 1.011231x; M32 was 0.977756x, 1.040790x, and 1.040749x, so neither bucket cleared 1.03x in every repetition and eager execution regressed.

approaches.summary: Measure the same score change inside packed-FP8 wq_b, fused BF16 wk_weights_proj, Q/K preparation, RoPE, quantization, and page-64 cache store.
approaches.why: M16 series were 1.014806x, 1.031918x, and 1.056648x; M32 was 1.028806x, 1.032633x, and 1.015328x, so the complete indexer failed the repeated 3% gate.

approaches.summary: Feed the exact top-k physical slots into the resolved TRT-LLM sparse DSA decode backend under bidirectional graph capture.
approaches.why: The selected-DSA median-of-series speedups were only 1.011807x at M16 and 1.020334x at M32, with every series below 1.03x.

approaches.summary: Repeat complete indexer plus selected DSA on four ranks and time the maximum rank without changing local M.
approaches.why: Diagnostic medians were 1.004793x at M16 and 1.023810x at M32; neither cleared the gate, and TP4 cannot substitute for TP8 acceptance.

lesson: For small-M paged score kernels, lower register/shared-memory use does not help when the grid already supplies only one CTA per SM and the score-to-top-k path is launch-underfilled. Gate the complete fill/score/top-k and downstream attention region; isolated score savings can disappear behind top-k, projections, and DSA.
transfers_to: small-M paged FP8 MQA on SM100
one-wave CUDA-graph kernels with separate materialization and selection launches
caveats: The exact production-shaped tensors are deterministic reconstructions; the real GLM-5.2 checkpoint and tokenizer were unavailable.
The host has four B200s, so the required TP8/DP8/EP8 end-to-end gate remains externally blocked and is not weakened.
Serving-native result JSON is not the frozen-task result.json schema; its raw samples, source hashes, pre/post correctness, and manifests are retained separately.
The first campaign had broken profiler commands and unbalanced graph capture order; it is explicitly superseded by the corrected campaign.
